title: Amazing day out.

title: Noelia is a 5 Star Plus Guide!
text: Noelia is a delightful, very knowledgeable tour guide. This was our first private tour and it was well worth it for us. She was a very competent driver and gave us incredible insight and information both on the trip to the Dalí Museum and in the museum, guiding us effortlessly to specific pieces and navigating us around crowds. Her enthusiasm is contagious! Her knowledge of Dali’s life, and in particular pointing out details hidden in specific paintings was impressive. title: Best way to have a Dali day
text:
Marcelo was an amazing guide.  Really appreciated his in-depth knowledge of Dali, which made the drive from Barcelona to the museum fly by.  Also, Marcelo was very friendly the whole trip.  His punctuality made the trip stress-free.

Really couldn’t imagine doing the drive myself and trying to find parking near the museum or in Cadaques.  Best to sit back and let the experts handle the logistics.  

Definitely would use this company for other tours in Barcelona, and would do this again.
author: A2703YPdougb

title: Adventures in Barcelona
text: Marcelo was our guide. He was early, friendly and very knowledgeable and informative.  He shared all the Salvady Dali history with us.  Air conditioning van which was comfortable and he drove with ease.  We went to Cadaques and enjoyed a delicious meal, walked around, shopped and had gelato!  It was a fun day with family and Marcelo. Highly recommend this tour.

title: A day of Dali
text:
I had a wonderful private tour with Hengameh and drive Augusto on the Dali Triangle Tour (Figueres, Cadaqués, and Portlligat).
The drive was beautiful and very comfortable. First, we visited the Dalí Theatre-Museum in Figueres, which was an amazing experience to learn more about Salvador Dalí and his unique artwork.

Then we continued to the charming seaside town of Cadaqués, where Dalí spent many summers. Costa Brava is absolutely stunning! I had lunch there by the beautiful coast. 🥘🌊
